# External Toxoplasma datasets (non-NHANES)

Participant-level data from open-access papers (supplementary files, CC BY 4.0), downloaded from Europe PMC by `scripts/external_datasets.py`.
Cite the original paper when using a dataset. Only the IgG result is used as the label; other Toxoplasma test columns are never used as inputs.

| folder | setting | source | DOI | file |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| indonesia_pregnant | Pregnant women, Makassar, Indonesia | Polanunu, Wahyuni & Hamid 2021, PLoS One | https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0245572 | pone.0245572.s001.sav |
| cameroon_hiv | People living with HIV, Bamenda, Cameroon | PLoS One 2021 | https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0256947 | pone.0256947.s001.xlsx |
| china_women | Women with gynaecological tumour + matched controls, eastern China | PeerJ 2022 | https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj.14569 | peerj-10-14569-s001.xlsx |
| myanmar_slaughter | Slaughterhouse workers, Yangon, Myanmar | PLoS One 2023 | https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0284352 | pone.0284352.s003.xlsx |
| iran_suicide | Suicide attempters + controls, Lorestan, Iran | BMC Infect Dis 2025 | https://doi.org/10.1186/s12879-025-11200-1 | 12879_2025_11200_MOESM1_ESM.sav |
| philippines_cebu | General population, Cebu, Philippines | PLoS One 2019 | https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0217989 | pone.0217989.s006.xlsx |
| thai_border_pregnant | Migrant/refugee pregnant women, Thailand-Myanmar border | Am J Trop Med Hyg 2017 | https://doi.org/10.4269/ajtmh.16-0999 | tpmd160999.SD1.xlsx |
| brazil_homeless | Homeless persons, Sao Paulo, Brazil | Front Public Health 2020 | https://doi.org/10.3389/fpubh.2020.580637 | Table_1.xlsx |
| ghana_sickle_cell | Sickle cell disease patients, Ho, Ghana | PLoS One 2026 | https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0346155 | pone.0346155.s002.xlsx |
